messages:
jules: Heads up – planning a staggered ramp + A/B experiment for the response-encoder change in production during tonight's change window (22:00-23:30 PT). Need approval and a quick check on the telemetry wiring before we push.

jules: Proposed traffic plan:
- 10% / 20m -> 30% / 20m -> 60% / 30m -> 100%
- A/B: variant-b (encoder V2) vs control (encoder V1), 50/50 within each ramp bucket

jules: Config blob (short):
```yaml
rollout: encoder-v2-experiment
step: [10,30,60,100]
step_duration: [1200,1200,1800,0]
ab_split: 50
guards: [latency-95: <600ms, error-rate: <0.5%]
```

deploy-bot: Automated checks started for thread 1943212345.
deploy-bot: Warning: missing telemetry-check pass. The metric `encoder_v2_qps` is not present on the rollout dashboard. Marking preflight: FAILED.

anya: @jules can we postpone 30m until raul confirms dashboard? last infra maintenance touched the telemetry pipeline.

sam: If telemetry is flaky, can we add a temporary guard to cap total ramp to 30% and require manual approval beyond that? less risky than blocking the whole change window.

raul: I looked at the pipeline — the exporter was redeployed earlier and missed relabeling. I can hotfix but it'll take ~25 min to get metrics flowing through.

marta: FYI ops will be running nightly DB vacuum at 22:15 which might slightly bump tail latency. Might affect the latency-95 guard.

jules: Options: (A) wait 25m for raul's fix and run full plan, (B) switch to manual gating: cap at 30% auto, manual to proceed, (C) abort tonight. I'm leaning B to keep momentum. Thoughts?

sam: +1 for B. Add a soft cap on ramp and require a human OK at the 30% checkpoint. Also add fallback routing to encoder-v1 on errors.

deploy-bot: Suggested command to set manual gate:
`/deploy set-rollout 1943212345 --max-auto=30 --require-approval-at=30 --fallback=encoder-v1`

jules: Doing that now. Pasting change command and brief notes for audit: 
```
/rollout apply --name encoder-v2-experiment --max-auto 30 --approval-step 30 --fallback encoder-v1 --guards latency-95<600ms,error-rate<0.5%
// reason: telemetry gap + ops vacuum; manual checkpoint requested
```

deploy-bot: Received command. Applying configuration. Preflight re-run...
deploy-bot: Preflight: OK except for telemetry-check (still missing) — manual approval required to proceed past 30%.

raul: I pushed the relabel fix to the exporter. Metrics should appear in ~4m. I'll post when it's live.

marta: Noted the DB vacuum; recommend we add a 5m buffer after 22:15 before doing the 30% bump. small risk but safer.

anya: @deploy-bot can you add a holdpoint hook at 22:25 to stop the next ramp until manual ack?

deploy-bot: Holdpoint scheduled at 22:25 PT. Will pause at the 30%->60% transition and require `/deploy approve 1943212345` from someone in the approvers group to continue.

jules: Thanks all. I'll monitor the dashboard during the first two steps. If telemetry looks clean after raul's fix and latency doesn't spike post-vacuum, I'll approve the 60% bump.

sam: I'll be on call during the window. ping me if any increase in p50/p95 or error traces.

deploy-bot: Audit note: rollout encoder-v2-experiment configured with manual gate at 30%. Change logged by jules. Thread locked to approvers for the approval action.

raul: exporter relabels live. I can see `encoder_v2_qps` on staging and now streaming to prod.

jules: Seeing metrics. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/rollouts/encoder-v2-experiment/telemetry

marta: DB vacuum completed at 22:18. No visible spike in p95 on staging replay.

jules: Approving 60% bump now. `/deploy approve 1943212345 // approved by jules`

deploy-bot: Approval received from jules. Continuing rollout to 60%. Monitoring guards.

deploy-bot: Guard check: latency-95 = 512ms (OK), error-rate = 0.13% (OK). Proceeding to 60% -> next hold at 100% requires another approval.

sam: Looks good from tracing. no new error traces. I'll stand by for final approval if needed. :thumbsup:

jules: If all stays green for 30m we'll finish the ramp to 100%. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 60% at 22:47 PT. Metrics streaming and guards within thresholds.

marta: Marking ops watch as cleared.

raul: closing loop: telemetry fix PR will land in main tomorrow for a permanent relabel fix.

jules: Closing thread — final approval will be in a follow-up if we need the 100% step. Good run. :rocket:
